title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department, pursuant to Chapter 164, Section 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under Chapter 79 of the General Laws for the right to take such rights of way, permanent easements, temporary easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the Towns of Charlton and Spencer.
